args: set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -x .venv/bin/fetch-guard ]; then python3 -m venv .venv; .venv/bin/python -m pip install --upgrade pip; .venv/bin/pip install .; fi; exec .venv/bin/fetch-guard
transports.description: Fetch Guard MCP server (stdio). Bootstraps a local .venv if missing.

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: Fetch a URL and return clean, LLM-ready markdown with metadata and prompt-injection defense.

trust.notes: Added for demo/testing as a vetted entry. Consider pinning to a specific upstream tag/commit for reproducibility.
